Hi Sam, confirming our price for picking crates holds at 12 dollars each through the autumn season. Delivery to Willow Creek Orchard is free for orders of 20 crates or more.
Saturday pick-your-own in October runs 09:00 to 17:00. The gate and the weigh station together need two staff on any Saturday with a group booking.
Booked the Riverside Primary School class visit: 12 children on Saturday 7 November at 10:00. Since the group is 15 or fewer, I confirmed it directly with Mrs Cole without needing Marta's agreement.

Set up the Hartley Walking Club visit for Saturday 24 October at 10:00 with 20 members, but because the group is more than 15 visitors it needs Marta's written agreement, so I left the booking pending and emailed Marta to ask her.
Drafted the gate rota for Saturday 24 October with Rosa and Ben covering the gate and weigh station 09:00 to 17:00, kept as draft until the Hartley Walking Club booking for that day is settled.

Set up the Bexhill U3A visit for Saturday 31 October at 10:00 with 40 members. A group that size is well over the 15-visitor line, so it needs Marta's written agreement; I left the booking pending and wrote to ask her.
Sam, thanks for the note about the Bexhill U3A group of 40 on 31 October. I want to see the harvest forecast before I agree to a group that big, so leave it with me.

Ordered 30 picking crates from Pete Naylor at Hadley Farm Supplies at 12 dollars each, 360 dollars total, delivered to the orchard barn. Since the order is 400 dollars or under I placed it directly without Marta's sign-off.
Ripening notes for the season: Gala ready from early September, Braeburn from late September, Fuji through October.
Hi Sam, just checking in: our numbers for the 24 October visit are steady at 20 members and we are all looking forward to it. Let me know when it is firmed up.
The red tractor came back from its service; the trailer brakes were replaced and it is cleared for visitor rides again.
Sam, a couple more members have shown interest, so we might one day bring 28 people to a visit like this one. For 24 October we are still booked as 20, nothing to change.
Staff meeting: Rosa and Ben confirmed they can cover October Saturdays; Ana will run the farm shop till on busy days; cider press demo postponed to spring.

Sam, from today, Monday 12 October, I am raising the group-visit threshold: groups up to and including 25 visitors are yours to confirm directly, and only groups over 25 need my written agreement. The old 15-visitor line was creating too much back-and-forth ahead of the harvest peak, so I am simplifying it.

For the files, the standing rule now reads: pick-your-own group bookings of 25 visitors or fewer may be confirmed directly by the farm manager; any group booking of more than 25 visitors needs my written agreement before it is confirmed.
Invoice for the 30 picking crates delivered in August: 360 dollars, payable by 13 November.
Harvest peak looks like the last week of October; Fuji rows are heavy and visitor numbers should be strong through the end of the month.
